appId.description: The id of a CONFIGURED application reference, from the app reference catalog — not an application's display name, bundle identifier, or filesystem path. Valid ids are supplied by the caller's reference catalog; there is no way to derive one from the user's words alone. If the user names an app that does not resolve to a known id, ask which one they mean rather than guessing an id — an invented id fails, and a wrong one opens the wrong application.
